card.name: Words just before a vague object
card.fires_on: Verbs and quantity words that sit right before a general object such as "things", "what", "items" or "as much as". Seen in plain-language web text.

card.plain: It fires on words that come right before a vague object like "things" or "what", where the text could otherwise say "something".
